lines.en: Investigation loop: contain before changing parameters

lines.text: 保护证据/ 单变量验证 / Qualification / Release
lines.zh: 保护证据/ 单变量验证 / Qualification / Release
lines.en: Preserve evidence / one-variable validation / qualification / release

lines.text: 工程权衡：范围过小可能漏掉连续风险；范围过大增加生产损失，需按严重度、复发性与证据动态调整
lines.zh: 工程权衡：范围过小可能漏掉连续风险；范围过大增加生产损失，需按严重度、复发性与证据动态调整
lines.en: Trade-off: narrow containment may miss ongoing risk; broad containment increases production loss. Adjust with severity, recurrence and evidence.

lines.text: 决定 Lot disposition、Chamber release与是否扩展同型设备
lines.zh: 决定 Lot disposition、Chamber release与是否扩展同型设备
lines.en: Determines lot disposition, chamber release and extension to similar equipment

lines.text: 边界与合规注记：停机、开腔、报废与放行必须遵守 Fab EHS、质量和班更管理制度
lines.zh: 边界与合规注记：停机、开腔、报废与放行必须遵守 Fab EHS、质量和变更管理制度
lines.en: Boundary and compliance: shutdown, chamber opening, scrapping and release must follow fab EHS, quality and change-management rules.
